headline: Joining Gonville and Caius College as a Fellow
html: Joined Gonville and Caius College, University of Cambridge, as a Fellow on 5 October 2026.

headline: Joining the University of Cambridge as Assistant Professor
html: Joined the University of Cambridge as Assistant Professor in the Department of Engineering, Information Engineering Division, Control Group, on 1 September 2026.

headline: Teaching dynamical systems at ETH Zurich
html: Teaching Introduction to Dynamical Systems at ETH Zurich with Prof. Khammash

headline: Presenting sparse biochemical network design at CDC 2025
html: Gave a talk at CDC, Rio de Janeiro

headline: Invited seminar on genetic controllers at Cambridge
html: Invited talk at University of Cambridge on Engineering Genetic Controllers to Accelerate Adaptation and Attenuate Cellular Noise

headline: Teaching control systems at Ashesi University
html: Another round of teaching Control Systems at Ashesi University in Ghana as part of the ETH for Development Masters Program

headline: Promotion to Senior Research Scientist at ETH Zurich
html: Promoted to Senior Research Scientist in BioSystems Science and Engineering, ETH Zurich

headline: Teaching control systems through the Ashesi–ETH programme
html: Taught Control Systems at Ashesi University in Ghana as part of the ETH for Development Masters Program

headline: Contributing to an SNSF Advanced Grant on genetic control systems
html: Our group received the SNSF Advanced Grant, which I contributed to, titled: "Theory and Design of Advanced Genetically Engineered Control Systems"

headline: Filing a patent on intein-based controllers
html: Filed a patent titled "Intein-based controllers"

headline: Organising an invited CDC session on biological controllers
html: Organized an invited session at the 61st IEEE Conference on Decision and Control in Mexico titled "Biological Controllers"

headline: Biomolecular PID invention recognised by the ETH Spark Award
html: Our PID patent ranked among the Top 20 Inventions Spark Award

headline: Filing a patent on cellular network control
html: Filed a patent titled "Expression system and method for controlling a network in a cell and cell comprising the expression system"

headline: Receiving the CCDC Best PhD Thesis Award
html: Received the Best PhD Thesis Award, Center for Control, Dynamical-Systems & Computations (CCDC)

headline: Joining ETH Zurich as a postdoctoral researcher
html: Started Postdoc in BioSystems Science and Engineering, ETH Zurich

headline: Completing a PhD at UC Santa Barbara
html: Completed PhD in Mechanical Engineering, University of California, Santa Barbara

headline: Completing an MS in Mechanical Engineering
html: Completed MS in Mechanical Engineering, University of California, Santa Barbara

headline: Receiving the UCSB Best Teaching Assistant Award
html: Received the Best Teacher Assistant Award at the Department of Mechanical Engineering, UCSB

headline: Receiving the CCDC Outstanding Scholar Fellowship
html: Received the CCDC Outstanding Scholar Fellowship

headline: Completing an MS at the American University of Beirut
html: Completed MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering, American University of Beirut
